description: Resuming with the other experimental multiplier can encode and reconstruct a layer with different codebooks.
trigger: Start a job with one experimental multiplier, then resume with the other; current CLI arguments pass the mutual-exclusion check before saved job settings are loaded.
expected_behavior: Reject the combined effective options or consistently select one codebook across encoding, decoding, reconstruction and inference.
actual_behavior: Both overridable options reach quant_args. quantize_tiles lets MUL1 override MCG; decode, reconstruct and test_distribution prefer MCG; GEMM and multi-GEMM reject both. quantize_exl3 stores both tensors.

introductions.rationale: 176 introduces the two experimental multiplier options and inconsistent selection rules.

verification.description: Reviewer traced argument validation before saved-job loading, resume overrides, multiplier storage and the divergent native dispatch rules.
verification.limits: Source only; no conversion, resume, CUDA kernel or model execution.

affected_revisions.limits: Reviewer source-supported revision only; no continuous range or executed failure established.

cutoff_note: Reviewer-only observation; never teacher input. Reviewer-originated label retained despite the ledger validator origin limitation.
